record.original_question: Can a 3-dimensional sphere admit two non-proportional projectively equivalent metrics of Lorentzian signature?

evidence.quote: Can a 3-dimensional sphere admit two non-proportional projectively equivalent metrics of Lorentzian signature?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Two pseudo-Riemannian metrics g and ḡ on a smooth manifold M are called projectively equivalent if every (unparametrized) geodesic of g is also an (unparametrized) geodesic of ḡ. They are called proportional if ḡ = c·g for some constant c ∈ ℝ (equivalently, on a connected manifold, for some smooth function that is forced to be constant when both metrics share the same Levi-Civita connection up to projective change).

Question: Does there exist a smooth Lorentzian metric g (i.e. a non-degenerate symmetric (0,2)-tensor field of signature (−,+,+)) on the 3-dimensional sphere S³ such that g admits a projectively equivalent Lorentzian metric ḡ on S³ which is not proportional to g?

Equivalently: can the 3-sphere S³ carry two non-proportional projectively equivalent metrics, both of Lorentzian signature?
artifact.status_search_result: The question appears in Burns–Matveev's list of open problems about geodesics. Related Lorentzian projective rigidity results (e.g., the projective Lichnerowicz conjecture for Lorentzian metrics, and 3-dimensional results on Levi-Civita metrics with projective vector fields) have been established, but no source found explicitly resolves the existence/nonexistence of two non-proportional projectively equivalent Lorentzian metrics on S³. The problem appears still open.

status_evidence.snippet: Compiled list of open problems about geodesics, including questions on projectively equivalent metrics in various signatures.
status_evidence.claim: The question is included in a curated list of open problems.

status_evidence.title: Local normal forms for c-projectively equivalent metrics; projective Lichnerowicz conjecture for Lorentzian metrics
status_evidence.snippet: Proof of the projective Lichnerowicz conjecture for Lorentzian metrics.
status_evidence.claim: Significant progress exists for Lorentzian projective rigidity, but does not settle the S³ question.

status_evidence.title: 3-dimensional Levi-Civita metrics with projective vector fields
status_evidence.snippet: Studies 3-dimensional pseudo-Riemannian metrics admitting projective vector fields.
status_evidence.claim: Related work in dimension 3 but does not address closed S³ Lorentzian existence.
